⚊ CELLAR SUITE, GOODWIN'S COURT
The Room

Down a quiet alley, behind an unmarked door.

Almost Blue sits below street level, where a low ceiling, brass fittings and a single upright piano set the pace for the evening. We pour slow cocktails and let a resident trio carry the room until close.

No signage, no shouting over the music — just good drinks, played and poured with intention.

Haven for music lovers
Cellar Suite, 7 Goodwin's Court
London WC2N 4LL

Open Tuesday – Saturday

Before You Knock
Do I need a reservation?+
Walk-ins are welcome at the bar, but table seating for weekend evenings fills quickly. We'd suggest booking a few days ahead through the contact form below.
Is there a dress code?+
Smart and understated. We'll happily seat you in denim if it's clean and considered — trainers and activewear we'll ask you to save for another night.
Is the lounge 21 and over?+
Yes. Almost Blue is an adults-only room after 6pm, and we do check ID at the door.
Can we book the room for a private event?+
The Cellar Suite can be booked in full for private sets, celebrations, and label nights. Send us your date and headcount through the contact form and we'll follow up with availability.
Is the space accessible?+
The entrance involves a short flight of stairs. Please get in touch ahead of your visit and our team will help arrange the best way in.
